title: Chapter 798
paragraphs: Chapter 798
Episode 197. The Red Name Tribe (2)
"Did you say their castles are underground?"
[To put it accurately, they are somewhere in between the surface world and the underworld.]

"Given that there are a total of five castles... this is a big deal. Even if they are halfway between the surface and the underworld, they are all located deeper than where you, Ameris, reside, aren't they?"
[That's correct, Jin. We can't go around destroying the whole world in an attempt to find their stronghold, so we'll have to track their surface activities carefully.]
Originally, the Red Name Tribe's castles all existed on the surface. They sank into the underground due to the sealing performed by Ameris in her heyday.

[I just remembered how fiercely the Red Name Tribe resisted when I sealed them. Even after sinking into the underground and being sealed, they pooled their remaining forces to create a spatial transfer device that connected to the outside. Now, when the seals on the tribal kings are released, the castles will rise to the surface again.]
"How advanced is the Red Name Tribe's technology?"
[From my experience living with you in Tikan and hearing general descriptions about the current era, the civilization on the surface now is drastically less advanced than it was in their time.]
According to Ameris, during the ancient times when the sun god existed, super long-distance communication and instant teleportation were very common.

Flying ships were not exclusive to large forces as they are now, and the biggest symbol of power was the sky fortress. There were mortal beings who possessed sky fortresses, capable of traveling freely and conducting conquest activities across all continents on the surface and even underground.
As Ameris was explaining, Jin recalled the moment when the main hall of the Temple of God, floating separated from other buildings, in Lafrarosa.
'Was the main hall of the Temple of God also a remnant of the sky fortress technology from those times?'
During the reconstruction of the main hall, which was destroyed after the Great King's Tournament, Jin and his siblings mostly performed roles close to manual labor.

Only Boras, the top engineer of the Bright Tribe, handled tasks that required high technical understanding. But even Boras said he couldn't fully understand all the technology applied to the main hall of the Temple of God.

[Among them, the Red Name Tribe had the most advanced technology. The Blue Name Tribe came next, although there was a gap. However, the Blue Name Tribe compensated for this with the overwhelming power of each individual. Their average combat power was much higher. It was a confrontation of technology and strength. Of course, at the peak, or among those equivalent, they were similar.]
Ameris naturally assumed that the science and civilization of her time could not continue to the present.

[In the ancient times, that is, before the death of the Sun God, everything that the immortals and mortals had achieved lost its meaning from the moment the world lost its completeness and became divided. There were endless wars between forces trying to control death and resurrection, and I was at the center of them. After the main actors of the war, including myself, were sealed, the world must have gone through several cycles of destruction and reconstruction.]
She concluded that civilizations had been born and disappeared several times in the world. She said that there was at least one more destruction after her death.

Therefore, the current Bright Tribe are the descendants of those left behind after the Red Name Tribe was sealed and the Blue Name Tribe was destroyed, and the occasionally discovered transcendental technology devices are the remnants of the first generation of high-level civilization that remained after cycles of repetition.
"Do you think it's the same underground?"
[Of course. From the moment the world was divided, those who were sent underground... were destined to be buried forever.]

"That's a bit harsh. Why did some go to the surface and some to the underground? Was it the existence of the Sun God who made that choice? Normally, the surface is considered better, I would have felt rebellious too."
At Enya's question, Ameris shrugged her shoulders.

[It's just an expression of being buried, the underworld has a good environment, not inferior to the surface. There is day and night there too. It's not a dark and gloomy world as you might think. For those who worship the sun god, the altar is closer, so that's another advantage.]
"Aha! So there's day and night underground."

[I think the fundamental responsibility for the war between the surface and the underworld lies with the underworld. If they had accepted the new order, if they hadn't looked down on the surface, there would be no reason for you to struggle now. However, those who disturbed the world for the resurrection of the Sun God are also just escaping their fate as mortals.]
Ameris's gaze turned to Jin.
[The monsters who struggled for so long to escape their fate are our enemies, you, me, and everyone here.]

"But the value of struggle is not determined by time alone. No matter how long they struggled, at the root of it all is a frail heart trying to find what was lost to the Sun God, trying to regain the ideal. If they fight me without knowing this fact, without overcoming it, they are bound to shatter."
Ameris's pupils widened at Jin's confident response.
Every word in his statement was sincere, without any fabrication. To Jin, the Red Name Tribe, the yet unseen enemies of the underworld, and the existing enemies were no different.
[Soldrelle has chosen a mortal very well. But don't underestimate them. When the seal of the Red Name Tribe starts to be lifted, the balance of the world will change.]
"So it's the emergence of the fifth force, following the Runcandel and Vamel Alliance, Gipple, Kinzelo, and the remnants of the Vermont Empire."
The fifth force.
"Now, only five have been resurrected, and two of them have met death by Jin, but the Red Clan have more than enough potential to justify their reputation.
The first targets of the Red Clan who started surface activities would be who?
For a moment, words about him passed among his comrades.

[My statement about the surface activities of the Red Clan being a hunt is not just a metaphor. They use the blood of life as their main nutrient. There is even a story that the reason their hearts are red is because of this.]
"Blood...?"
[A large amount of blood is needed to break the seal. The blood of a strong individual shows a more exceptional effect.]
"So, there's a high chance they'll carry out indiscriminate massacres."

[To do that, they do not have a means to transport that many lives or blood, and to begin with, the blood of livestock or untrained mortals has little effect. That's why even in their heyday, the Red Clan did not often kill life that they deemed worthless from their point of view. Like beasts, they only hunted as much as necessary.]
At those words, Jin inwardly clenched his chest.

He was confident that he could crush the resurrected members of the Red Clan no matter how many times they fought, but if they suddenly appeared somewhere among the population, quickly massacred the common people, and disappeared, there was no easy way to prevent this. Already, many people had been killed in such massacres during the demon god war.

[Furthermore, if they kill too many lives, how will they transport all those bodies and blood to the fortress? Return magic is not omnipotent. It demands a high price to use a fellow tribesman as a catalyst to escape from you, so it cannot be used for worthless blood.]
"Is it the same for the subspace storage function installed in the bracelet that Dr. Qwaul took?"

[Subspace storage also has spatial limits. A first-class warrior like Shimat would have space for at least one flying ship, but he would not move directly due to unsealing. Therefore, the ones moving are the remaining two second-class warriors, and the size of their storage is at most about thirty full-grown humans.]

The Red Clan, unlike the Blue Clan, and the current Bright Clan, had a society where everything was determined by rank. Even the size of the subspace storage that they could possess differed according to rank.
Perhaps because the last ones she fought were the Red Clan, fortunately, Ameris had a considerable amount of memory about them.
"Miss Ameris, you said there would be about a thousand Red Clan in the fortress. To awaken their hearts and break the seal... the blood of about sixty ordinary humans would be meaningless."
[Jin, a human like you could probably awaken them all and then some, but, hmm... right, Jet. Let's consider Jet as a standard.]
"Eek, me?"
[In my opinion, the blood needed per warrior would be about two or three Jets.]

Jet was looking at the late 6-star skills (thanks to Gilley who taught him intermittently). He was infinitesimally insignificant in the world of superhumans and monsters, but by general standards, he was an incredible powerhouse.
"So, if there are about three warriors like me, we can beat one Red Clan average warrior?"

[Hmm... Don't even dream about it, Jet. You're not a warrior, you're an intelligence agent. Even if there were three of you, the magnitude of power might be similar to an average warrior of the Red Clan, but they are the Bright Clan. They're not even a match.]
"So, from the perspective of the Red Clan, the best land to obtain a life with Jet-level combat power is...."
It would inevitably be the territory of most large forces. Small kingdoms would only have 7-stars for their royal guards, and average knights and magicians can barely exceed 5-stars.
Suddenly.
A region's name flashed through Jin's mind.
"The land of the Beastmen...?"
The territory of Kinzelo, the land of the Beastmen.
As the name suggests, Beastmen live there. Among them, the most numerous were the combat tribes, the Red Tiger Tribe and the White Wolf Tribe.

In fact, when the Red Tiger and White Wolf tribes first saw Jin who obtained the Heartlight, they instinctively gave up the fight, urinated like scared dogs. Even now, the average warriors of the two combat tribes can't even look directly at Jin's murderous eyes.
If they show the same reaction to the Red Clan.
There could be no easier prey. Moreover, as 'combat tribes', the Red Tiger and White Wolf tribes had combat power of over 6-stars as adults.
"They will surely target the land of the Beastmen. If I were the Red Clan, there would be no better hunting ground."

[Ah, the land of the Beastmen. Were they called the Red Tiger Tribe and the White Wolf Tribe, I remember there were some guys whose origins I couldn't know. They are probably hybrids of the lower tribes that existed at the time. There could be nothing more suitable for the Red Clan to hunt.]
As Jin predicted.
The Red Tiger Tribe and the White Wolf Tribe, who were patrolling the outskirts of the Beastmen's land, were already facing Andolin and Ozen.
And those Beastmen were out of their minds, trembling at the sight of the glowing Heartlight.
"Wh, who are you...! Why, why are you doing this?"

"Huh? There really were such hybrids. Just watching you a moment ago, you were bullying non-combat Beastmen quite well. Show us the same spirit, so that our fellows can consume a life that jumps more!”
It was the moment when the eerie tales of the Red Clan began among the Beastmen of Kinzelo.
